items.text: Boat groups now spawn every 5–8 hours, each lasting 30–60 minutes before disappearing.
Fixed PT boat being stuck in the deepsea; it can now be taken out like other boats.
AI Sleep Zones now initialize correctly outside of BaseEntity structures, restoring proper sleep behavior.
Animals now flee when attacked from a distance and no longer sleep.
Sheep feeding time synced with cows, preventing starvation despite troughs.

Boat scientist AI improvements: only attempt turns when the player is visible, give up after chasing for a while, limit pursuit distance, swap to a new target if the current one is obstructed or hidden, and turn the boat around when no crew can see the target.
Cows can now satisfy their light requirement using lamps, and clipping through walls while lying down has been fixed.
Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack in its output before removal.
Research Table no longer crashes when a research attempt finishes because the removed item's definition is now preserved.
ItemContainer.Clear loop reimplemented to safely invalidate items after iteration, fixing potential item loss.
Cookable items cache necessary information before being destroyed, preventing null‑reference errors during cooking.
Default item pool increased from 512 to 2,048 slots, reducing overflow and batch removal issues.
Sprinklers now reliably emit splash effects, maintain a valid fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes is fixed.
Fixed infinite power console variable that broke static CCTV cameras, restoring their functionality.
Animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.
Added support for water guns and water pistols, and radwater splashes now use green effect variants.
Ramp line-of-sight now correctly accounts for additional positions, fixing blue LOS blockage.
Death-screen sleeping-bag buttons no longer mis-size or overlap, preventing misclicks.
Bags assigned while dead now appear on the map immediately, fixing loss of bag markers after death or rejoin.
Underwater crates now contain blueprint fragments and pages, matching other loot pools.
Adjusted random gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon and small shark: 20% chance now yields a blueprint fragment instead of 8 cloth.
AI Sleep Zones now work correctly, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.

Boat scientist AI now only attempts turns when the player is visible, switches targets if the current one is obstructed, rotates to face players when unseen, and gives up chasing after a maximum distance or time or when shot.
Sheep feeding bug fixed so they no longer starve at troughs, and cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down, and animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.
Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory overflow.
Default item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 to stop overflow issues.

Gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small shark adjusted; 20% chance to get 8 cloth replaced with 20% chance to get a blueprint fragment, and blueprint fragments/pages added to underwater crates.
Fixed sprinklers skipping splash effects, temporary null fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes; sprinklers now start with proper water.
Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; added support for water gun and water pistol with viewmodel integration.

2026-10-26.summary:
### AI & NPC Behavior
- AI Sleep Zones now work correctly, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.
- Boat scientist AI now only attempts turns when the player is visible, switches targets if the current one is obstructed, rotates to face players when unseen, and gives up chasing after a maximum distance or time or when shot.

### Livestock & Farming
- Sheep feeding bug fixed so they no longer starve at troughs, and cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
- Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down, and animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.

### Item & Crafting
- Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory overflow.

### Loot & Item Pool
- Default item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 to stop overflow issues.
- Gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small shark adjusted; 20% chance to get 8 cloth replaced with 20% chance to get a blueprint fragment, and blueprint fragments/pages added to underwater crates.

### Sprinklers & Radwater
- Fixed sprinklers skipping splash effects, temporary null fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes; sprinklers now start with proper water.
- Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; added support for water gun and water pistol with viewmodel integration.

items.text: Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.
Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.
Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.
Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

2026-10-25.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
- Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

### Farming
- Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
- Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

### Building & UI
- Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
- Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

### Bug Fixes
- Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

items.text: Shears now harvest 25% more wool, have double durability (200), and deal reduced damage (4 slash + 4 stab), making them a more efficient wool‑gathering tool.
Network packet batching reduces latency and improves responsiveness; can be toggled at runtime.
Fixed viewmodel camera bone positioning, correcting misaligned weapon view.
